title: For the 2015/2016 season, identify the top 3 leagues with the most matches
question: For the 2015/2016 season, identify the top 3 leagues with the most matches where the home team lost. Among players who played as home_player_1 in these losing matches and are taller than 180 cm, what is their average overall rating?

prediction.sql:
WITH losing_leagues AS (
    SELECT m."XCL_008" AS league_id
    FROM "Match" AS m
    WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
      AND m."XCL_015" < m."XCL_016"
    GROUP BY m."XCL_008"
    ORDER BY COUNT(m."XCL_006") DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT AVG(pa."XCL_132")
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN losing_leagues AS ll ON m."XCL_008" = ll.league_id
JOIN "Player" AS p ON m."XCL_061" = p."XCL_122"
JOIN "Player_Attributes" AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND m."XCL_015" < m."XCL_016"
  AND p."XCL_126" > 180
